note: Polymarket: the price 24 hours before each beat market closed (the consensus branch keeps them). Our model: a logistic regression fitted only on earlier reports — "frozen" rows were published before the report, "backtest" rows are the monthly walk-forward (each month predicted by a model fitted on the months before). A call is right when the probability is on the side of 50% the result fell on. History is what the consensus collector has gathered (about four quarters per company). Not investment advice.
